exposure: metformin combined with insulin aspart therapy
metformin combined with biosynthetic human insulin therapy
cohort: A total of 145 patients with gestational diabetes mellitus were included in the study: 78 in group A (metformin combined with biosynthetic human insulin therapy) and 67 in group B (metformin combined with insulin aspart).
finding: Metformin combined with insulin aspart was more effective in controlling blood glucose and improving pregnancy outcomes compared to metformin combined with biosynthetic human insulin in the treatment of gestational diabetes mellitus.
